steps.en: The latest company email address is fetched from the government data service
steps.id: Alamat email terbaru perusahaan diambil dari layanan data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The refresh is switched off in every environment, so the stored email is used instead.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan ini dimatikan di semua environment, jadi email yang tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each company owner is identified once and its notices are combined into one email
steps.id: Tiap pemilik perusahaan diidentifikasi sekali dan notice-nya digabung dalam satu email
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates are not combined, so one company can still receive more than one email.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tidak digabung, jadi satu perusahaan bisa menerima lebih dari satu email.

steps.en: Companies that opted out or have no valid email are not emailed
steps.id: Perusahaan yang menolak atau tanpa email valid tidak dikirimi email

steps.en: The email lists outstanding notices and mentions the 2nd letter
steps.id: Email memuat notice yang masih outstanding dan menyebut surat ke-2
steps.why_en: The message text lives in the database, so it cannot be confirmed that it refers to the 2nd letter.
steps.why_id: Teks pesan ada di database, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan menyebut surat ke-2.

steps.en: The email reminder is sent to the company owner in a batch
steps.id: Email reminder dikirim ke pemilik perusahaan dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: The reminder job and email sending are switched off in the production settings, so nothing is sent.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman email dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi tidak ada yang terkirim.
